title: Suriname signs novel project to strengthen resilience against environmental shocks
temporal_coverage: Flood vulnerabilities and proposed investments described inFebruary 2025.
methodology: Project approval announcement and local drainage diagnosis.
limitations: Expected benefits are plans, not evaluated results.

title: El Niño in the Amazon: Building resilience to crises in Suriname
temporal_coverage: Interior consultations and anticipatory-action planning reported inSeptember 2026.
methodology: WFP field-mission account and community consultation.
limitations: Qualitative operational account; no national causal estimate or evaluated effectiveness.

title: Climate change adaptation investments for the resilience of Paramaribo
temporal_coverage: Project period 2024-2026 shown on publisher page.
methodology: Implementer's project objectives and expected results.
limitations: Expected outcomes and project dates do not establish completion or publication date.

title: The Republic of Suriname’s First National Adaptation Plan Progress Report
organization: Ministry of Spatial Planning and Environment, Republic of Suriname
temporal_coverage: Reviews national adaptation progress for 2020-2024; report published 1 April 2025.
methodology: NAP implementation reviewed against indicators using questionnaires, focus groups, interviews and a validation workshop.
limitations: Some indicator data were unavailable; the report is not an impact evaluation.

title: Suriname Systematic Country Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: Diagnostic drafted mainly in 2023; includes 2022 flood observations and a 2023 household phone survey.
methodology: World Bank diagnostic based on two 2022 country visits, stakeholder interviews, literature review and a household phone survey.
limitations: The report cautions that some conditions may have changed since drafting; flood and land-rights sections synthesize earlier sources.

title: Climate Resilience for Food Security in Suriname
organization: Inter-American Institute for Cooperation on Agriculture (IICA), Water and Agriculture platform
temporal_coverage: Project listing states implementation from 2023 to 2024 and finalized status.
methodology: IICA implementer account of field assessments, farmer meetings, demonstration plots and project lessons.
limitations: Project-page account is not an independent evaluation and provides no controlled outcome estimate.

title: Building Indigenous Maroon Farmers’ Resilience to Climate Change Guaranteeing Food Security in Suriname
organization: Inter-American Institute for Cooperation on Agriculture (IICA)
temporal_coverage: Project listing states dates 8 May 2025 to 30 June 2026; current implementation status is not stated.
methodology: IICA project listing summarizing the problem statement, planned training and demonstration-site activities.
limitations: The page states intended activities, not completed outcomes; it does not name participating villages.
